Difference.description: One element the built page lacks or shows differently from the design.

built.description: What the build shows, when it shows the element.

element.description: The element, such as `flow graph` or `status badge`.

kind.description: Whether the build lacks the element or shows it differently.

Difference.title: Difference

description:
`changes/conformance/v1`: what a critic with a clean context found when
it screenshotted the built page and compared it with one version of the
artifact the owner agreed.

It lives at `/changes/<name>/conformance/<n>`. The review gate passes
when a record at the change's head says `match` and lists no difference,
and otherwise shows each difference of the records at the head.

change.description: The change whose build was compared.

differences.description: Each element of the version the build lacks or shows differently.

head.description: The commit the screenshot was taken at.

mockup.description:
The mockup, as the plan's Mockups list names it: a URL or a board
path.

page.description: What was screenshotted: the URL or file of the built page.

screenshot.description: Where the screenshot is saved, when it is kept.

verdict.description:
Whether the build matches the version: `match` only when
`differences` is empty.

version.description: The version of the mockup the build was compared with.

title: ConformanceRecord
